title: TEOS Common Definitions
description: Reusable JSON Schema definitions shared by TEOS object contracts. This schema is a definition library and is not itself a TEOS source object.

uuid.title: UUID Identifier
uuid.description: A stable TEOS identifier encoded as a UUID.

semanticVersion.title: Semantic Version
semanticVersion.description: A semantic version identifying a compatible object, schema, renderer, generator, template, or contract revision.

date.title: Calendar Date
date.description: A full calendar date independent of a time of day.

dateTime.title: Timestamp
dateTime.description: An RFC 3339 date and time with an explicit UTC offset.

time.title: Local Time
time.description: A local wall-clock time used with an explicitly owned IANA time zone.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: A positive quantity of instructional or preparation time. It is never an assigned date, clock time, or institutional period count.

unit.description: The unit in which the duration quantity is expressed.

localizedString.title: Localized String
localizedString.description: Text with a required default value and optional translations keyed by BCP 47 language tag.

translations.description: Alternative text keyed by BCP 47 language tag.

lifecycleStatus.title: Source Object Lifecycle Status
lifecycleStatus.description: The shared lifecycle state for maintained TEOS source objects.

artifactLifecycleStatus.title: Artifact Lifecycle Status
artifactLifecycleStatus.description: The lifecycle state for a generated TEOS artifact.

sessionType.title: Session Type
sessionType.description: The canonical instructional mode of a Session.

artifactType.title: Artifact Type
artifactType.description: A canonical logical artifact category defined by the Rendered Artifact specification.

outputFormat.title: Output Format
outputFormat.description: A canonical output serialization or document format.

availabilityStatus.title: Availability Status
availabilityStatus.description: The explicit availability of an instructional date or period.

referenceObjectType.title: Reference Object Type
referenceObjectType.description: The TEOS object or separately versioned resource targeted by a reference.

reference.title: Version-bound Reference
reference.description: A generic version-bound reference preserving the stable identity, declared type, and exact version of its target without copying ownership. Use only for intentionally polymorphic relationships.

object_type.description: The type of the referenced target.

identifier.description: The stable identifier of the referenced target.

version.description: The exact intended version of the referenced target.

role.description: The documented role the referenced target has in this relationship.

locator.description: An optional location within the referenced target, such as a requirement section.

standardReference.title: Standard Reference
standardReference.description: A version-bound reference that targets only a Standard.

competencyReference.title: Competency Reference
competencyReference.description: A version-bound reference that targets only a Competency.

instructionalUnitReference.title: Instructional Unit Reference
instructionalUnitReference.description: A version-bound reference that targets only an Instructional Unit.

sessionReference.title: Session Reference
sessionReference.description: A version-bound reference that targets only a Session.

courseReference.title: Course Reference
courseReference.description: A version-bound reference that targets only a Course.

institutionProfileReference.title: Institution Profile Reference
institutionProfileReference.description: A version-bound reference that targets only an Institution Profile.

academicCalendarReference.title: Academic Calendar Reference
academicCalendarReference.description: A version-bound reference that targets only an Academic Calendar.

renderedArtifactReference.title: Rendered Artifact Reference
renderedArtifactReference.description: A version-bound reference that targets only a Rendered Artifact.

templateReference.title: Template Reference
templateReference.description: A version-bound reference that targets only a Template.

resourceObjectReference.title: Resource Object Reference
resourceObjectReference.description: A version-bound reference that targets only a separately maintained Resource object.

documentObjectReference.title: Document Object Reference
documentObjectReference.description: A version-bound reference that targets only a separately maintained Document object.

policyReference.title: Policy Reference
policyReference.description: A version-bound reference that targets only a Policy.

scheduleReference.title: Schedule Reference
scheduleReference.description: A version-bound reference that targets only a Schedule.

assessmentObjectReference.title: Assessment Object Reference
assessmentObjectReference.description: A version-bound reference that targets only a separately maintained Assessment object.

generatorReference.title: Generator Reference
generatorReference.description: A version-bound reference that targets only a Generator.

rendererReference.title: Renderer Reference
rendererReference.description: A version-bound reference that targets only a Renderer.

assetReference.title: Asset Reference
assetReference.description: A version-bound reference that targets only an Asset.

destinationReference.title: Destination Reference
destinationReference.description: A version-bound reference that targets only a Destination.

referenceList.title: Reference List
referenceList.description: A non-empty collection of unique, generic version-bound references for an intentionally polymorphic relationship.

organization.title: Organization Identity
organization.description: An identifiable organization or governing owner.

identifier.description: The authoritative identifier for the organization.

name.description: The approved name of the organization.

uri.description: The authoritative URI for the organization when available.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Classification labels that do not replace explicit TEOS relationships.

metadata.title: Source Metadata
metadata.description: Authorship, revision, and provenance metadata that does not alter the object's canonical meaning.

maintainer.description: The organization responsible for maintaining this object.

created_at.description: The timestamp at which this version was created.

modified_at.description: The timestamp of the most recent change to this version.

revision_notes.description: A non-empty explanation of revisions represented by this version.

source.description: The source from which this metadata or object was derived.

extensions.description: Namespaced, non-authoritative extension metadata. Extension names must begin with x-.

resourceReference.title: Resource Reference
resourceReference.description: A curriculum-owned requirement for a resource capability, service, consumable, or supporting asset, without an institutional assignment.

requirement.description: The educationally significant capability or material requirement.

quantity.description: The required quantity when educationally significant.

reference.description: A version-bound reference to a separately maintained resource.

documentReference.title: Document Reference
documentReference.description: A citation or version-bound reference to a publication, policy, controlled document, or authoritative source.

title.description: The title of the cited document.

publisher.description: The publisher or governing owner of the document.

uri.description: A resolvable URI for the document when available.

version.description: The official document edition or version.

locator.description: A section, page, clause, or other location within the document.

reference.description: A generic version-bound TEOS reference when the cited publication, policy, controlled document, or source is separately maintained. The permitted target types intentionally match this polymorphic citation wrapper.

safetyReference.title: Safety Reference
safetyReference.description: A required curriculum safety control stated independently of local assignments.

control_type.description: The documented category of safety control. The architecture does not yet define a closed vocabulary.

requirement.description: The control that must be satisfied before or during instruction.

source.description: The governing safety source when applicable.

assessmentReference.title: Assessment Reference
assessmentReference.description: A curriculum assessment or evidence expectation tied to one or more Competencies.

description.description: The evidence, assessment method, or evaluation expectation.

competency_references.description: The Competencies evaluated by this expectation.

assessment_reference.description: A version-bound reference to a separately maintained Assessment object.
